name: Getting Even
overview: Scripture teaches that responding to wrongs with vengeance is unwise and contrary to God's will. Instead of seeking to 'get even,' believers are called to exercise patience and trust in the Lord to deliver justice, as Proverbs 20:22 advises waiting on the Lord rather than repaying evil. A soft answer and self-control can defuse anger, while love towards enemies and doing good to those who hate us embody Christ's transformative call to live differently from the world (Luke 6:27; Romans 12:2). God's presence and strength provide the foundation for this godly response, assuring believers of His support and righteousness (Isaiah 41:10).
